Origin and meaning

Noah is a Hebrew name meaning “rest, comfort”.

About the name Noah

Noah built the ark that saved his family and the animals from the flood.

As a gift or a tattoo

Because it means “rest, comfort”, a Noah calligraphy print makes a thoughtful gift for someone who loves the name or its meaning.
